title: Wings Under Glass
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.Ysolde Fairweather has seen luna moths glowing at midday northeast of the great gate, and she wants wings whole enough to study.

About

Given byYsolde Fairweather
Level40
LengthShort
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

  • Unbroken Luna Wing ×8

Steps

  1. Talk to Ysolde Fairweather (outdoors around 1733, 1795) to get the quest.
  2. Unbroken luna wings (8) - Unbroken Luna Wing at 1732, 1795

Rewards

Reward
Gold7,200
Character XP225,000
Quest points1

What Ysolde Fairweather says

Ysolde Fairweather: Hold it up to the window. See the veins? The light is moving along them, very slowly, from the body out to the edge.

Ysolde Fairweather: That's how sap rises in a stem. Something out there is feeding these moths light.

Ysolde Fairweather: Here, for your trouble. I'll have more questions once I've had these under the lens.

Handing it in
